Commit a264cf5e81c7 (""scsi: ibmvfc: Fix command state accounting and stale
response detection"") introduced a regression in detecting duplicate
responses. This was observed in test where a command was sent to the VIOS
and completed before ibmvfc_send_event() set the active flag to 1
resulted in the atomic_dec_if_positive() call in ibmvfc_handle_crq()
thinking this was a duplicate response

column2: so we then hit a SCSI command timeout for this command once

column1: the timeout expires.  This simply ensures the active flag gets set prior to
making the hcall to send the command to the VIOS
